params.1274: Acquire tin and copper ore (you can mine some if you have a pickaxe).
params.1275: Bob's Brilliant Axes in Lumbridge can give you a pickaxe.
params.1276: Use a furnace and choose 'Bronze' to smelt the ores into a bar.
params.2225: Smelting metal will give you Smithing experience. Bars once made can be used to make weapons, armour and tools.
